summary.content:
Today's selection covers 58 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 34 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic Expands Mythos 5 Access to More Defenders, Unveils $35M Open Source Fund
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CISA orders urgent patching of actively exploited Zimbra flaw
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 17 articles published in the last 24 hours
